scripts.lint: eslint apps packages tests scripts *.ts *.mjs --max-warnings 0 && node scripts/uv.mjs run --frozen ruff check .
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && node scripts/uv.mjs run --frozen ruff format --check .
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @smartdesk/shared build && pnpm -r typecheck && node scripts/uv.mjs run --frozen mypy app
scripts.test: vitest run && node scripts/uv.mjs run --frozen pytest
scripts.test:database: pnpm db:generate && pnpm --filter @smartdesk/server build && node tests/integration/database.mjs
scripts.test:messages: pnpm --filter @smartdesk/shared build && pnpm --filter @smartdesk/server build && node tests/integration/messages.mjs
scripts.test:realtime: pnpm --filter @smartdesk/shared build && pnpm --filter @smartdesk/server build && node tests/integration/realtime.mjs
scripts.test:frontend: pnpm --filter @smartdesk/shared build && pnpm --filter @smartdesk/server build && node tests/integration/frontend.mjs
scripts.test:reception: pnpm --filter @smartdesk/shared build && pnpm --filter @smartdesk/server build && node tests/integration/reception.mjs
